name: NAVTTC Hunarmand Pakistan (Prime Minister's Youth Skills Development Programme)
target_group: Unemployed or underemployed youth wanting free technical/vocational/digital training
summary_en: Free 3-6 month training courses (traditional trades, IT/digital skills, freelancing) with NVQF-recognized certification, aimed at improving employability. No income test.
summary_ur: 3 سے 6 ماہ کی مفت تربیت (روایتی ہنر، آئی ٹی، فری لانسنگ) سرٹیفیکیٹ کے ساتھ، بے روزگار نوجوانوں کے لیے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Unemployed applicants and applicants from under-developed/rural areas are typically given preference, but employment status is not a hard disqualifier for most courses - check the specific course listing.

required_documents: CNIC (or Form-B for applicants without a full CNIC yet)
Educational certificate (Matric or as required by the chosen course)
Domicile certificate (only if the specific course has a regional quota)
application_steps: Browse open courses on the National Skills Information System (NSIS) portal
Pick a course matching interest and eligibility (education level, age)
Submit CNIC and educational documents as requested
Await confirmation of seat allocation from the training institute
disclaimer: Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.
